data.title: A 10.5-foot, 8,710-pound seabed drone found its own ship off Nova Scotia, latched onto a camera-guided hook and rode onto the deck with nobody at the controls. That job is still done by crews leaning over the rail with poles, on a machine built to pick potato-sized rocks off the ocean floor
